hide_notes: FittedFloor and Baseboard: meshes only; their collision (FittedFloorCollision boxes, SunkenLanding, BaseboardCollision) stays. The lining floor is exactly floor_y everywhere except the sunken entry landing under the door swing, where it copies FittedFloor's own surface so it matches the SunkenLanding collider. HouseInterior__WingOpeningFrame is replaced by the lining's timber archway.
floor_coverage: 37414 downward samples (5 cm) over both floors rectangles: 35083 hit the lining floor at floor_y (max deviation 0.014 cm); 2048 lie in the sunken entry landing and match FittedFloor within 1 cm (mean 0.03 cm); 283 (0.8 %) miss because the rectangles reach under the inset walls or past the skin.
